## Battlefield of Eternity
**Directives**: RACE. Burn the Immortal.

🚫 **TARGETED BANS**: **Illidan**, **Genji**, **Tracer**

### 🎯 STRATEGIC PRIMARY
**Raynor** (Ranged Assassin)
> Utilize 'Exterminator' at Level 1 to achieve elite Immortal race velocity (90+ DPS); maintain a 6.6 range positional tether to sieging Immortals to avoid the 1.5s stun telegraph.
`[T1231214,Raynor]`

### 🔄 STRATEGIC BACKUPS
**Sylvanas** (Ranged Assassin)
> Prioritize Black Arrows on the Immortal during the 20s burn phase to disable nearby structures for the follow-up push; focus 'Wailing Arrow' (R) on the enemy healer to secure the objective win.
`[T1211221,Sylvanas]`
**Gazlowe** (Bruiser)
> Establish Turret City 15s before the Immortal centers; focus fire the enemy racer to force a retreat while your 3+ turrets deal consistent 98 DPS to the objective.
`[T2112123,Gazlowe]`
**Rehgar** (Healer)
> Cycle Earthbind Totem (E) into a 2s slow window to peel for your racers; reserve Bloodlust (R) for the 50% HP mark of the enemy Immortal to secure the race victory.
`[T2311321,Rehgar]`

## Infernal Shrines
**Directives**: ZONE. AoE Clear for Shrines.

🚫 **TARGETED BANS**: **Kael'thas**, **Johanna**, **Tracer**

### 🎯 STRATEGIC PRIMARY
**Johanna** (Tank)
> Use Condemn (W) to group objective guardians for instant clear; reserve Shield Glare (E) to blind enemy racers during the 40-guardian burn phase.
`[T1221234,Johanna]`

### 🔄 STRATEGIC BACKUPS
**Gazlowe** (Bruiser)
> Establish Turret City 15s before shrine activation to create a defensive perimeter; zone the objective pit to force enemy trades while you secure the 40 guardians.
`[T2112123,Gazlowe]`
**Kerrigan** (Melee Assassin)
> Chain Ravage (Q) kills on shrine guardians to maintain 100% uptime; utilize Primal Grasp (W) into Impale (E) only when the enemy tank attempts to contest your 40-kill lead.
`[T1211234,Kerrigan]`
**Stitches** (Tank)
> Utilize Putrid Bile (R) to zone enemies off Shrines for the full 10s duration; maintain a 12-unit positional tether to pull targets into the shrine pit for focused guardian clear.
`[T1211214,Stitches]`
